player_prompt.intro: Kuna wasa Hasumiyar Hanoi tare da {num_disks} fayafai. Dole ne ku matsar da fayafai daga hasumiya A zuwa hasumiya C. Don matsar da fayafai, rubuta hasumiyar tushe da hasumiyar manufa (misali, '[A C]). Lura cewa za ku iya matsar da fayafai na sama na hasumiya, kuma ba za a iya sanya fayafai mafi girma a kan ƙaramin fayafai ba. A kowane juyi, gabatar da motsi ɗaya.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Ka ƙayyade tushen da ba daidai ba ko hasumiyar manufa.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Ka yi ƙoƙarin matsar da faifai daga hasumiya da babu kowa a ciki.
invalid_move.same_tower: You tried to move a disk to the same tower.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: You tried to place a larger disk on a smaller disk.

game_action.moved: Ka matsar da faifai {disk} daga {source} zuwa {target}.

outcome.win: Barka dai, kun warware matsalar Hasumiyar Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: An kai iyakar juyawa. Daidai ne ka sanya {pct}% na disks a kan Hasumiyar C.
